01_setup_prereg_feasibility.ipynb: Pre-registration, Drive-backed project setup, resilient rate-limited GitHub client with on-disk cache, and a feasibility probe testing adoption-signal detectability and CI-history depth before full collection.
02_frame_and_G1_validation.ipynb: Stratified sampling-frame collection (3 popularity bands x 5 languages) with the software-project filter, plus the G1 adoption-detector validation gate: gold-set construction, dual-coding read-back, Cohen's kappa, and precision/recall with Wilson CIs against the gate criterion.
03A_adoption_dating_and_panels.ipynb: Adoption dating (earliest datable high-confidence signal), control pseudo-dating from the treated distribution, and resumable construction of repository-month activity and CI panels, split by data source.
03B_matching_did_eventstudy.ipynb: Propensity-score matching with SMD balance; two-way fixed-effects DiD on all outcomes (log1p) with repository-clustered SEs and Benjamini-Hochberg correction; event-study parallel-trends test; trend-adjusted reanalysis; placebo test; heterogeneity by band and language.
04_carbon_accounting.ipynb: Converts CI-minutes to energy and CO2e under the SCI/Green-Algorithms/CCF model across low/central/high factor scenarios; computes the adopter-cohort carbon band and the naive-vs-trend-adjusted attribution gap. Reframed: reports association and the attribution gap, not a causal carbon effect.
05_assembly_robustness_artifact.ipynb: Assembles all results into paper-ready tables and figures, runs the remaining robustness checks, and packages the replication artifact.
